context_requirements: Expression of ADRB2 and/or other adrenergic receptors on the cell surface
For antiproliferative/apoptotic effects, dependence on Raf-1/MEK/ERK signaling
For metabolic/mitochondrial effects, presence of PGC-1α-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis machinery
falsifiers: No induction of cAMP-responsive immediate early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, DUSP1) at 6 h in any cell line
No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h in cell lines known to express ADRB2
Lack of any transcriptional response across all nine cell lines

evidence.supports: β2-adrenergic receptor agonist causes apoptosis and tumor regression by blocking Raf-1/MEK/ERK pathway
β2-adrenergic receptor agonist formoterol induces mitochondrial biogenesis via PGC-1α
β3-adrenergic receptor agonist mirabegron improves glucose homeostasis and induces beige adipocyte gene expression
α1A-adrenergic receptor agonist activates ERK and protects cardiomyocytes
β3-adrenergic receptor agonist reduces liver steatosis and inflammation

changes: Removed CXCL2 and PTGS2 from proximal_up: these are inflammatory mediators, not canonical cAMP/PKA immediate-early genes, and their induction is not a direct proximal effect of adrenergic receptor agonism.

Removed generic proliferation and stress genes from proximal lists: cell-cycle genes (MYC, CCND1, CCNE2, E2F2, CDK4, CDK6, PCNA, MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, PLK1, UBE2C, CDC20) are downstream consequences of antiproliferative signaling, not proximal transcriptional targets of adrenergic receptors.
Kept late_up and late_down as downstream metabolic and cell-cycle effects, consistent with mitochondrial biogenesis and antiproliferative mechanisms.
Kept line_response as moderate/weak based on known ADRB2 expression and lineage: A549, HCC515, MCF7, PC3, VCAP moderate; A375, HA1E, HEPG2, HT29 weak.
Kept kinetics fast and magnitude moderate, consistent with cAMP/PKA immediate-early induction and delayed cell-cycle effects.

Kept evidence citations: all five abstracts support the stated claims about adrenergic receptor agonist effects on apoptosis, mitochondrial biogenesis, glucose homeostasis, ERK activation, and steatosis/inflammation.
